name: Moshimo Konna Shopping Mall ga Attara!? Ikimasu☆
original_name: もしもこんなショッピングモールがあったら!? いきます☆
source:
There is a big shopping mall called "Moshu-Mall". It looks normal at first sight, but the mall is actually famous for its erotic services such as "Shoppers Ero Paradise", "Grand Oppai Square", "Tsurupeta Harenchi Garden", "Fetish Plaza", and "Viva! Hustle Park". Only some chosen people are allowed to go inside! Yes, Naoki is one of them. "Welcome to our ero shopping paradise!"

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090724182928/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012036]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
有一座名为“莫修商城”的大型购物中心。乍看之下平平无奇，实则以“购物者桃色乐园”“巨乳大广场”“贫乳羞耻花园”“恋物癖广场”以及“万岁！激情乐园”等色情服务而远近闻名。唯有少数被选中的幸运儿才获准入内——没错，直树正是其中之一。“欢迎光临我们的桃色购物天堂！”
